title: ChainIT Transaction Truth: Stablecoins, Web3 Wallets, and Multi-Rail Commerce. A Zero-Trust Control Plane for Verified Identity, Organizational Authority, Runtime Compliance, Secure Wallet Execution, and Immutable Settlement Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.24659v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stablecoins can move value continuously across programmable networks, and Web3 wallets can authorize those transfers with cryptographic signatures, but neither capability, standing alone, establishes a complete commercial transaction. A blockchain may prove that a transaction satisfied protocol rules, and a wallet may prove that sufficient signing authority existed; neither proves who initiated the transaction, for which legal entity, under what current authority, against which current compliance evidence, on what exact instruction, or with what settlement and accounting outcome. translated_title: ChainIT交易真相：稳定币、Web3钱包与多轨道商务——面向已验证身份、组织权限、运行时合规、安全钱包执行与不可篡改结算证据的零信任控制平面
translated_abstract: 稳定币可以通过可编程网络持续地转移价值，Web3钱包可以通过加密签名授权这些转账，但这两项能力单独来看都无法构成一个完整的商业交易。区块链可以证明某笔交易满足协议规则，钱包可以证明存在足够的签名权限；但两者都无法证明交易是由谁发起的、代表哪个法律实体、基于什么现行权限、依据什么当前合规证据、按照什么确切指令执行，以及带来怎样的结算与会计结果。我们描述了ChainIT交易真相架构（ChainIT Transaction Truth Architecture），这是一个零信任的控制、执行与证据架构，它将已验证的个人和组织身份、ChainIT Authority Protocol的组织权限记录与权限策略、针对具体交易的运行时合规决策、精确摘要审批、原子化容量预留（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ChainIT交易真相架构，通过零信任控制平面整合已验证身份、组织权限记录、运行时合规决策与不可篡改的结算证据，使稳定币与Web3钱包的转账成为完整、可审计的商业交易。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the ChainIT Transaction Truth Architecture, a zero-trust control plane that integrates verified identity, organizational authority records, runtime compliance decisions, and immutable settlement evidence to turn stablecoin and Web3 wallet transfers into complete, auditable commercial transactions.
